empluk_yeardummies.source: empluk plus one 0/1 dummy per calendar period after the first (1977-1984), regressors in the order log_wage, log_capital, d1..d8

empluk_mundlak.source: empluk plus each firm's mean of log_wage and of log_capital over its observed years, regressors in the order log_wage, log_capital, mean_log_wage, mean_log_capital

empluk_without_1980.dataset: empluk with calendar period 4 (1980) unobserved for every firm

fd_first_appearance_time_axis.dataset: empluk as an entity-major long frame (plm's natural order)
